corrections.finding: No dedicated deterministic ARPG combat authority existed between the Stage02 player CharacterCore and Living NPC state.
corrections.resolution: Added ARPGCombatCore with player-health delegation to CharacterCore, enemy gameplay overlays and isolated combat-event persistence.

corrections.finding: Initial unit harness selected an NPC explicitly marked combat_targetable=false and expected damage.
corrections.resolution: Kept the runtime guard; corrected the harness to select a valid combat target. TARGET_NOT_COMBAT_TARGETABLE remains enforced.

corrections.finding: Stage03 initially replaced the exact legacy implementation_stage string used by Stage01 consumers.
corrections.resolution: Restored the legacy field unchanged and added combat_activation_policy as a separate backward-compatible field.

corrections.finding: Expanded validation expected an enemy counterattack while that enemy was still under hit-recovery/stagger.
corrections.resolution: Advanced authoritative combat time before the counterattack; retained stagger action blocking. Validation reran to 67/67 PASS.

corrections.finding: Initial grouped Stage03 stress execution exceeded the harness execution window.
corrections.resolution: Reran the stress suite independently while preserving multiple profiles/targets, replay, status ticks and persistence invariants; completed 17/17 PASS.

corrections.finding: Grouped V1.5 legacy regression runs exceeded the execution window because each case rebuilds a country-scale world.
corrections.resolution: Executed the four critical V1.5 suites by isolated cases; aggregate result 24/24 PASS. Grouped timeouts remain recorded as inconclusive rather than PASS.
